---
title: "Get all vendors"
description: "Retrieve a paginated list of all vendors"
api: "GET /vendor"
---

## Query Parameters

<ParamField query="page" type="object">
  Pagination parameters
</ParamField>

## Example Response

```json
{
  "vendors": [{
    "Id": "1234",
    "Name": "John Smith",
    "Email": "john.smith@mailsac.com",
    "Is_Company": false,
    "Address_Street1": "123 Main St.",
    "Address_City": "New York",
    "Address_State": "NY",
    "Address_Country": "US",
    "Address_Type": "primary"
  }],
  "pagination": { "total": 1, "page_size": 10, "page": 0 }
}
```
